title: blobmap manifest
description: Blob definitions for one scope. Pure definition: this changes only when the set of blobs changes, never on reads, writes, tiering or restores.

schema_version.description: Format version. Consumers must reject a version they do not know rather than guess.

scope.description: Prefix these definitions apply to, relative to the data store.

epoch.description: Bumped whenever the definitions change, so a resolver can detect staleness without diffing.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the producing run.

generated_by.description: Package and version that produced this.

policy.description: Thresholds used to produce this cut, recorded so a later run can tell whether they changed.

hot_always.description: Glob patterns that are never archivable, whatever the blobs say. Metadata objects and dimension coordinates.

blobs.description: Blob definitions. A list of rules, so its length tracks cut decisions rather than object count.

id.description: Join key against tier state, and through it against tape addresses.

prefixes.description: Key prefixes this blob claims, relative to the scope. More than one when small arrays were coalesced.

bucket.description: Arithmetic for cutting inside an array. Null means one bucket, so the resolved id is always id_0.

index.description: Which segment after the prefix holds the chunk index.

width.description: Objects per blob along that dimension.

key_encoding.description: How to parse the index out of a key.

provenance.description: Measured numbers, for debugging only. These go stale while the manifest is untouched, so a resolver must never read them.
